profile.provenance: Original AMUN MK7 EUR stable set: coin and cup/trophy/star goals only. EUR effective version 3152 only; fingerprint live-text-crc32-v1:004EC000:2BE03E4B. Cup-major [cup*4+class] ordering and the gold/star bitfield decode were hardware-confirmed on an original 2DS (2026-09-22). Race, ghost and Time Trial goals are in the separate experimental set. Not an official or third-party achievement set.
